# BMS Pro

> Unified booking and operations platform for mechanic shops, salons, and trades — built for Australian service businesses.

BMS Pro is a suite of three products that share one platform: BMS Pro Workshop (mechanic shops), BMS Pro Salon (salons & beauty), and BMS Pro Trade (trades & services). Based in Lynbrook, Victoria, Australia.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Platform overview and product suite.
- [Products](/products): All three BMS Pro products.
- [BMS Pro Workshop](/products/black): Workshop operations and job booking for mechanic shops.
- [BMS Pro Salon](/products/pink): Appointment booking for salons, spas, and personal services.
- [BMS Pro Trade](/products/blue): Job scheduling for trades and service businesses.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Plans and pricing for all products.
- [About](/about): Company story and team.
- [Careers](/careers): Open roles and how to apply.
- [Blog](/blog): Product updates and industry insights.
- [Contact](/contact): Book a demo or get in touch.
